house_boundary_rule: Traditional planet is assigned from cusp H inclusive to next cusp exclusive as oriented increasing tropical longitude modulo 360, for each chart's fixed research-place astronomical geometry. Every seven-body membership partition tested source-by-source.
source_critical_limits: The house p115 score is ONE accidental-strength component. Original Lilly combines essential dignities (with mutual reception and essential debilities) and other accidental components; no source-authorized total from the original cache.
Which quadrant house system operationalizes first printed Lilly rules remains historically debated; neither can be substituted silently.
Numeric source points from a body in a house do not imply that body's manners-significator eligibility, historical necessary precedence or actual personality prediction.
Exactly unique maximal house-only score does not imply a complete or source-approved Lord of the Geniture, Lilly CVII manners significator, or Ptolemy III.13 soul governor.
The 4,553 Ptolemy source candidates are themselves four-mode conditional modern reconstructions, not a psychologically validated population.
Each HD state may appear with multiple different Western house circumstances; HD interval presence counts must never be added across branches.
Other originally printed p115 planetary velocity, orientation, beams, aspects, fixed stars and lunar nodes are still source-incomplete.
